prominence._note: Per outlet, the strongest signal for the story; P = mean over covering outlets.

merge._note: After clustering: one call over story titles, newest headlines and publish times that joins stories that are the same event or a direct follow-up. methods.merge = "none" switches it off.

analysis._note: Phase 1. Stories selected = top N ranked (a few more than the episode's story count, so stories without readable text or a failed synthesis can be replaced). Articles: one per covering outlet (its best piece), every outlet included; maxArticlesPerStory is only a safety cap for the per-story step's time limit, applied by taking turns across left, center and right.
analysis._trafilatura: Trafilatura runs as a Python function (api/trafilatura.py) after JSON-LD and before Readability; off = skip it. If it fails or is unreachable the chain moves on.

script._note: Phase 2. Word budgets at ~150 spoken words a minute, by position in the episode (storyWords[0] = lead); stories past the end of the list get its last value. 5 stories ≈ 3 min each: the first two longer (~3.6 min), the next three shorter (~2.6 min). The writer aims for the budget and stays under budget × maxOverBudget. Short episodes are fine: budgets are capped, never padded.
script._templates: Fixed (non-LLM) segments around the stories, in this order: welcome, rundown, [stories], outro. Remove a kind from 'templates' to drop it; {stories} in the rundown becomes the top 'rundownTop' story titles, plus 'and more' when there are others.
script.welcome: This is Prism News, where we read across the spectrum so you don't have to.
script.outro: That's the news for today. This has been Prism News. Catch you tomorrow.

speak._note: Phase 3, before voicing: the spoken text (docs/pronunciation.md). Code rules, then one Claude call over the episode returning find/replace edits, checked in src/audio/spoken.ts. methods.speak: sonnet-spoken-v1 (rules + Claude), rules-only, none (voice reads the display text).

audio._note: Phase 3. Every segment is voiced with the same voice and format so they join by concatenation. Audio is cached by hash(text + voice + provider + format).

news._note: Public news pages (src/news). A ranked story is listed when at least minOutlets distinct outlets cover it. 'Play this section' fills the chosen length (minutes) with voiced stories in rank order; a story that would pass the length by more than overflowSec is skipped.

feedback._note: Send to Claude buttons on the site open GitHub issues in this repo (labels feedback + feedback:<area>). Needs GITHUB_FEEDBACK_TOKEN in Vercel.
